purpose: Overnight Bronze Serpent film, session authorization (production/approvals/session_2026-11-02_overnight.md)

params.prompt: Close-up study sheet for a prestige 2D animated biblical short film. Hand-painted illustration with confident gouache brushwork, simplified planes, clean readable silhouettes and two-tone cel shading with soft painted edges. Mature and dignified. Realistic adult proportions about seven heads tall, small heads, long limbs, real hands with fingers, restrained faces shaped by light and shadow. Never cartoonish, never big eyes, not a children's book, not photorealistic, not 3D. Plain ancient Near Eastern dress in wool and linen, muted earth colors: umber, clay, ash, undyed wool. Warm low light from the left, cool blue-grey shadow on the right. Each close-up is separated from the others by generous empty space, nothing overlapping, no ground, no props other than those stated. Transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no borders. Match the reference images exactly in painting style, brushwork, level of finish, faces, costumes and color world. The sheet shows four large close-ups, left to right, evenly spaced, each one cropped cleanly at the chest with a soft painted edge: 1. King Hezekiah from the reference, head and shoulders in side profile facing right, jaw set, resolute and grieved, gold circlet, ember-red mantle. 2. the exhausted seated man from the reference, head and shoulders in side profile facing right, head tilted back, gazing up and to the right, hope just beginning. 3. two weathered adult hands and forearms entering from the bottom, raising a small bronze offering bowl with a few glowing coals in it, side view. 4. Nicodemus from the reference, head and shoulders in side profile facing right, head lifted, gazing up and to the right in quiet astonishment, warm gold light falling on his face from above.
